answer: Stop sybils with random squad liability. First, the network deals every new identity into a random squad of seven strangers, scattered across a nebula — no choosing teammates. Second, the squad locks a shared 350 POA bond, 50 POA each, and must finish one real paid task in 14 days. Third, if one member proves fake, the whole bond burns, so members police their own group. Forging 10,000 fakes means infiltrating 1,429 squads, risking 500,000 POA and $3,000,000. Like a pearl around one grain of sand, seven strangers share one fate, and one saffron thread of suspicion unravels the strand.
